name: ci-runner
install: set -e; go mod download; go build ./...; GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.27.1 GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.13.1; grep -qxF 'export PATH=$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH' $HOME/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH=$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH' >> $HOME/.bashrc
